meta_tools.name: codespar_charge
meta_tools.description: Propose the Pix charge of one open order the customer asked to pay: one charge, for exactly the order's total, due today (a cobrança com vencimento the customer settles by Pix). This does NOT issue anything: it creates an execution in `drafted` that the code checks against the collection policy and the order (one order per charge, the amount equal to the order's total) and, depending on the approval mode, asks the store or issues. The code builds the real call and presents the QR and the copia-e-cola; you never see or pass a document. action=status reads back the state of a charge this run proposed.

action.description: create (the default) proposes the charge; status reads one back.

order.description: The order alias from list_orders (pedido-2001). Never a name, a document or a Pix key typed in the chat.

amount_minor.description: BRL cents: the order's `total_minor` from list_orders. The code refuses any other amount.

total_minor.description: Optional. What you believe the total is. The code recomputes it and yours is only recorded.

local_tools.name: list_orders
local_tools.description: The store's open orders, with `today` (the date a charge is due): alias, customer's first name, item, total in BRL cents and status (open, Pix issued, paid). Read-only. Documents are not returned.
